articles.title: Kalshi’s crypto perpetuals spark debate over whether they’re futures or swaps
articles.snippet: A clash between derivatives veterans is exposing a deeper discussion over how U.S. regulators should classify crypto perpetual contracts.

articles.title: Monero price rockets 33% to $438 amid $120 million onchain laundering maze
articles.snippet: Onchain sleuth ZachXBT traced remaining funds across exchanges, instant swap services and other blockchains. Tether later froze $72 million in USDT linked to the activity.

articles.title: Former SEC, CFTC Chair Gary Gensler argues that prediction markets don't overrule state regulations
articles.snippet: The former regulator joined a number of interest groups in arguing that prediction markets are overstepping their bounds by offering sports-related contracts.
